finalText:
Redis died at `02:14:07` and never came back.

The cache was serving 98% of reads. Losing it sent every request straight to the store. Store reads began timing out at 5 seconds. The request queue grew for 17 minutes straight. It passed its 500 limit at `02:29:12`.

`worker-2` ran out of memory at `02:31:44`. The supervisor killed the API at `02:31:52`. Service down.

All 13 reconnect attempts failed with `ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. They fired every 80 seconds with no backoff.
